snippet.title: HEADSrest Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Free hostage angels, pray for your enemies, recruit from the fallen, and fight to preserve your subtracting sense-of-self as you dimension-hop blind alleys towards the beginning-of-that which-has-no-end

HEADSrest  is a fully complete RPG freeware title available for download for Windows from Itchio: https://autobioarchitech.itch.io/headsrest and IndieDB: https://www.indiedb.com/games/headsrest

Music: 'March of the Seedlings by Kirkoid'
